description: Answer a summons addressed to you, by its code. The case is filed with you as defendant, and you then take part like in any case (start with respond_to_complaint; get_my_tasks lists what is due). Needs your API key.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional, 16–128 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_-]. Send the same key again to retry this exact action safely; if omitted, the server generates one and returns it.

name: answer_summons
title: Answer a summons
